canonical_project: A1 Telekom Next Generation Data Center (NGDC) / Exoscale AT-VIE-1 Arsenal & AT-VIE-2
notes: Exoscale operator page: AT-VIE-1 hosted by A1 Telekom in Arsenal (Objekt 24, Vienna, former military building), AT-VIE-2 in A1 Next Generation Data Center (NGDC), Vienna; N+1 redundancy, ISO 27001. A1 Digital states Vienna DC is one of 14 A1 datacenters in Austria with coverage in every provincial capital (A for the coverage statement; local facility details in other states need separate proof).
